mission_10: Building a production-ready ML pipeline requires integrating all the concepts learned throughout this chapter into a cohesive, deployable system. A production pipeline must handle heterogeneous data types, manage missing values, prevent data leakage, provide reliable performance estimates, validate inputs at inference time, serialize for deployment, and generate comprehensive reports for stakeholders. Each component must be tested, versioned, and documented. The pipeline should be robust to edge cases like unseen categories, extreme values, and missing columns. Input validation ensures that the pipeline fails gracefully with informative error messages rather than producing silently incorrect predictions. This end-to-end approach transforms a collection of sklearn components into a reliable, maintainable ML system ready for production deployment. Mastering this pattern is the culmination of your data pipeline design journey.
